title: Girl I've gone on a few dates with mentioned persistent dream world she visits
content: She's not someone who has ever heard of reddit, and is definitely not privy to the idea of 'MallWorld' dreams from any sort of discovery online. I was asking her about her dreams as we had each drank absinthe the night before, and my own had been incredibly vivid (although not MallWorld, which I do visit from time to time). She said that hers were not remarkable that evening, but that she often visits a remarkably persistent alternate world in her dreams. Lo and behold, she described MallWorld. Her exact words initially were 'My dreams are often just my dream world. I get deja vu a lot". I asked her to elaborate, and she said "There's a really big mall that I go to often. It's not someplace I've ever been to in real life." She then immediately went on to a totally different subject in our conversation, clearly not thinking much of this statement. This conversation was via text messages, so I didn't push any further at the time. When I see her next I will ask her some questions about her MallWorld dreams and bring back the details in another post. Anyone want to drop some questions you'd like me to ask her below?
